## Activity

During May 2022, Hill Counties Health Centre recorded 75 captures. This activity represents the completed capture work reported for the month. The results provide the basis for the image-quality review and subsequent grading outcomes. Capture activity should continue to be recorded consistently so that monthly performance can be monitored and any operational issues can be identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 75 captures, 4 were marked ungradable by graders. The ungradable rate was 5.3% of captures. These results should be reviewed as part of routine quality assurance. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support follow-up and help maintain image quality at Hill Counties Health Centre.

## Grading

A total of 9 results were graded referable. The median lag for grading was 23 days. This measure should be considered alongside the capture volume, the ungradable results and the referable findings when reviewing monthly service performance. Continued recording of grading activity and operational issues will support oversight of the service and help identify areas requiring attention.
